name: media-rig-workspace
description: MediaRig component library and documentation workspace.

scripts.build:registry: shadcn build registry.json --output apps/docs/public/r && node scripts/finalize-director-registry.mjs
scripts.build:site: pnpm run build:registry && pnpm --filter @media-rig/docs run build:site
scripts.test: pnpm --filter media-rig run test && pnpm --filter @media-rig/docs run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter media-rig run typecheck && pnpm --filter @media-rig/docs run typecheck
